bio.text: Katherine Robertson is the Republican nominee for Alabama attorney general in 2026; she won the June 2026 runoff over former Alabama Supreme Court Justice Jay Mitchell.
She serves as chief counsel to Attorney General Steve Marshall, a role she has held for nearly a decade, according to her campaign website.
Earlier she was a clerk and counsel to Sen. Jeff Sessions on the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee and vice president of the Alabama Policy Institute, according to her campaign.
She is a graduate of Auburn University and the University of Alabama School of Law, and lives in Birmingham.
